project_metadata.name: KSA Enterprise HRMS Core
project_metadata.compliance_target: Saudi Arabia Labor Law & ZATCA Phase 2

global_development_rules: NEVER write vanilla CSS (.css files). Use Tailwind utility classes exclusively.
ALL layout structures must use logical properties for dynamic RTL/LTR support (e.g., use 'ps-4' instead of 'pl-4', 'me-2' instead of 'mr-2').
DO NOT hardcode language strings. Every piece of UI text must be routed through the translation dictionary hook.
Components must remain presentation-only or localized state-only. All shared global state (User, Theme, Language) must hook into the Master Context Providers.

security_and_geofencing: Every page route must be wrapped in the RBAC validation hook (`useCurrentRole()`). If unauthorized, redirect to the unauthorized fallback shell.

Attendance punch events must trigger the `GeofencingSafetyProvider` matrix validation. If GPS accuracy is > 15m or outside the office radius boundary, block the action and flag an exception log payload.
ksa_labor_law_math: Overtime (OT) calculations must utilize the standardized core engine formula: (Basic Salary / 30 / 8) * Hours * 1.5 for standard overtime.
Friday or official public holiday work must calculate at a minimum rate of 1.5x basic wage + an additional 50% premium modifier.
GOSI deductions must execute conditionally based on nationality fields: 10% employee / 10% employer for Saudi citizens; exactly 2% employer hazards-only for expat listings.
zatca_compliance: Every generated invoice component must render standard fields in BOTH English and Arabic simultaneously in a side-by-side or stacked block layout.
The QR code module must accept a pre-computed Tag-Length-Value (TLV) hexadecimal string array. Never render raw text strings inside a compliance QR asset.
theming_and_typography: Components must read color themes dynamically using Tailwind variable layers (e.g., use `bg-primary` or `text-muted` rather than hardcoded colors like `bg-blue-600`).
Text elements must inherit the global scale classes (`text-dynamic-sm`, `text-dynamic-base`, `text-dynamic-xl`) to scale cleanly with the user's settings panel configuration.
